{{Quote|Kyle, we need you back at Ops! They've got us pinned down!|[[Unidentified New Republic commander|New Republic commander]]|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Ops''' was the center of operations for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|base]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]]. During [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> two [[Imperial artificial asteroids|mobile asteroid weapon facilities]] entered synchronous orbit and began bombarding the base's shields.<ref name="MOTS" /> Within the remote outpost,<ref name="Story">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_story.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Story}}</ref>, the base's leadership&mdash;a [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]], [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|fellow]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], and an [[Unidentified New Republic officer (Altyr V)|officer]]&mdash;converged at Ops to discuss the their strategy against the asteroids and incoming Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], according to a report from [[Delta 3]]'s outpost.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[File:Altyr V base command central.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Altyr V base commanders strategizing.]]
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Katarn decided to steal an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]] to infiltrate the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], and then he departed as Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|invaded]]. When Ops came under direct attack from Imperial forces drilling through a wall, [[New Republic soldier/Legends|Republic forces]] counterattacked. Katarn eventually returned to Ops to help fend off the Imperials, though the commander, under Jade's protection, had already moved to a more secure location. Katarn left Ops under the remaining officer's command and moved to help repel other invading soldiers. Eventually the New Republic repelled Imperial attackers long enough for the New Republic troops to escape before the primary attack force arrived.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ops appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" />
